description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage team building AI-powered software and infrastructure for automating supply chain integrations. You will help shape foundational systems that connect the agent platform with a reliable runtime for integrations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build purpose-specific AI coding agents for supply chain connectivity.

 - Develop and maintain infrastructure for hosting and running integrations.

 - Own core systems end to end, from agent tooling to integration runtimes, and make key architectural decisions.

 - Establish engineering patterns and practices as the team and product grow.

 - Work across agentic software and backend infrastructure, including orchestration and cloud systems.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to five years of experience as a full-stack or backend software engineer.

 - Proficiency in TypeScript and modern full-stack development, with experience in technologies such as React, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and AWS.

 - Hands-on experience building with AI agents or LLMs using current development patterns.

 - A track record of autonomous, hands-on engineering and building products or systems from scratch in an early-stage environment.

 - Experience with backend or infrastructure systems such as runtimes, orchestration, or cloud platforms, beyond product UI work.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals, demonstrated through relevant education, early-stage company experience, founding work, or substantial technical projects.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Base salary: $150,000 to $300,000 annually.

 - Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
